items.item: A stepper names each step and lets the user go back to earlier steps
items.evidence: renderStepper() renders ol#stepper with STEPS = Tải file lên / Ghép cột / Xem trước / Nhập; earlier steps become <button data-act="goto"> when k<S.step (disabled only on the final step 4), plus a Quay lại button in each step bar.

items.item: Column mapping auto-matches headers and marks required target fields
items.evidence: autoMap() matches normalised headers against FIELDS[].syn and sets S.auto; view2 shows an 'Tự động ghép' badge, red '*' with sr-only '(bắt buộc)' on req fields, 'Chưa ghép' badge and blocking validation in toPreview().

items.item: The preview table shows per-row errors and an error count, and offers to download the failing rows
items.evidence: view3: summary line '… lỗi' count, tabs Tất cả/Hợp lệ/Có lỗi with counts, per-row 'Kết quả kiểm tra' column listing r.errs, banner with 'N dòng có lỗi' and button 'Tải dòng lỗi' (data-act=dl-failed -> failedCSV()).

items.item: The import shows progress, can continue in the background, and ends with a summary of created, updated and failed rows
items.evidence: view4 running: role=progressbar #jobBar, 'Đang nhập x / y dòng (%)', button 'Chạy nền' (data-act=background, jobs view + header #jobsBtn + completion toast); result: figures Tạo mới / Cập nhật / Lỗi / Tổng and a failed-rows table with download.

items.item: The flow runs on a page or a full-width panel, not inside a small modal
items.evidence: Wizard renders in main#main (max-w-6xl) as section cards at /page level with breadcrumb; the only dialogs (dialog()) are small confirmations for cancel/leave/stop.

items.item: A template file is offered for download before upload
items.evidence: Step 1 shows header button 'Tải file mẫu' and sidebar link 'Tải file CSV mẫu' (data-act=dl-template -> download('mau-nhap-san-pham.csv', ...)) beside the dropzone; visible in the first-viewport screenshot.

notes: Audit score 100, no violations. Flat white/slate surfaces, blue-700 primary, 4-6px radii, no gradient/glass/emoji/uppercase labels, no KPI tiles, no hover-lift. Sidebar is white, not navy. Avatar 'LH' is the signed-in person's own account, not a non-person initials avatar. Status badges use semantic tones (success/warning/info/danger) with text labels, not rainbow. Minor: step-4 result figures are bordered boxes inside a bordered section card (mild card-in-card), not counted as a tell. Step 4 stepper entries are not clickable, which is fine since going back after import starts would be meaningless. Review based on markup and screenshot of step 1; later steps judged from script logic, not rendered.
